name: Cocoyam Root Rot
description: A soil-borne disease causing decay of cocoyam roots and corms. It is favored by waterlogged conditions and can cause significant yield losses, especially in poorly drained soils.
symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of leaves starting from older leaves
Corm decay starting from the base
causes: Continuous cocoyam cultivation in same field
treatments: Improve drainage immediately in affected fields
Apply metalaxyl or fosetyl-aluminum to soil
Remove and destroy severely affected plants
prevention: Plant on ridges or raised beds to ensure drainage
Incorporate organic matter to improve soil structure
